FACT_ID: sec08-R01 | anchor: A01
Far vision reads 20 to 30 seconds down your path, while side and mirror sweeps guard crossers and trailers [A01].
Why it matters: group safe-driving; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec08-F02, sec08-F03 [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ky-d:kentucky-state-police-ksp-driver-testing:handbook:pdf-0057]

FACT_ID: sec08-R02 | anchor: A01
Open-road defaults run 65 and 55 MPH, while settled areas drop to 35 and lots to 15 [A01].
Why it matters: group safe-driving; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec08-F05 [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ky-d:kentucky-state-police-ksp-driver-testing:handbook:pdf-0057]

FACT_ID: sec08-R03 | anchor: A02
Darkness caps speed at headlight range, while 100-foot storms cap it at 25 miles per hour on low beams [A02].
Why it matters: group safe-driving; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec08-F06 [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ky-d:kentucky-state-police-ksp-driver-testing:handbook:pdf-0058]

FACT_ID: sec08-R04 | anchor: A02
Curves want braking done before entry, while mid-curve stomps break traction [A02].
Why it matters: group safe-driving; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec08-F08 [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ky-d:kentucky-state-police-ksp-driver-testing:handbook:pdf-0058]

FACT_ID: sec08-R05 | anchor: A02
Plain brakes pump gently on slick roads, while anti-lock brakes take one steady press [A02].
Why it matters: group safe-driving; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec08-F09 [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ky-d:kentucky-state-police-ksp-driver-testing:handbook:pdf-0058]

FACT_ID: sec08-R06 | anchor: A02
Wet roads want slower speeds and sound tread, while flooded roads want a different route entirely [A02].
Why it matters: group safe-driving; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec08-F10 [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ky-d:kentucky-state-police-ksp-driver-testing:handbook:pdf-0058]

FACT_ID: sec08-R07 | anchor: A02
Total stopping distance spans realization to rest, while perception time covers only the recognition slice [A02].
Why it matters: group safe-driving; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec08-F11 [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ky-d:kentucky-state-police-ksp-driver-testing:handbook:pdf-0058]

FACT_ID: sec08-R08 | anchor: A03
Reaction time moves the foot in 3/4 second to 1 second, while braking distance then spends about 158 feet from 50 mph [A03].
Why it matters: group safe-driving; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec08-F12 [A03].
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-ky-d:kentucky-state-police-ksp-driver-testing:handbook:pdf-0059]

FACT_ID: sec08-R09 | anchor: A03
Normal gaps hold four seconds by the thousand-count, while slick, dark, heavy, and twitchy company demands more [A03].
Why it matters: group safe-driving; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec08-F15, sec08-F16 [A03].
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-ky-d:kentucky-state-police-ksp-driver-testing:handbook:pdf-0059]

FACT_ID: sec08-R10 | anchor: A05
Blind spots want you gone by speeding or dropping back, while your own tailgater wants steady speed and early signals [A05].
Why it matters: group safe-driving; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec08-F18, sec08-F20 [A05].
Source: [A05 -> src:rdmv-ky-d:kentucky-state-police-ksp-driver-testing:handbook:pdf-0061]

FACT_ID: sec08-R11 | anchor: A05
Ordinary backing borrows a ground guide, while a missed interstate exit forbids backing altogether [A05].
Why it matters: group safe-driving; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec08-F22, sec08-F23 [A05].
Source: [A05 -> src:rdmv-ky-d:kentucky-state-police-ksp-driver-testing:handbook:pdf-0061]

FACT_ID: sec08-R12 | anchor: A06
Light taps warn drifters and cutters, while blasts near blind pedestrians and anger-honks stay banned [A06].
Why it matters: group safe-driving; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec08-F26 [A06].
Source: [A06 -> src:rdmv-ky-d:kentucky-state-police-ksp-driver-testing:handbook:pdf-0062]

FACT_ID: sec08-R13 | anchor: A06
Signals precede every move and slowdown, yet grant no right-of-way and must be mechanical, prompt, and cancelled [A06].
Why it matters: group safe-driving; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec08-F27, sec08-F28 [A06].
Source: [A06 -> src:rdmv-ky-d:kentucky-state-police-ksp-driver-testing:handbook:pdf-0062]
